description: Lists the workspace’s connected integration accounts, one page at a time, or reads one when id is given. Each has its integration, name, status, the WhatsApp numbers it is used on and the reason it last failed, if it did. A credential is not part of the answer. Labels and error text come from the provider and are marked untrusted. Read-only.

after.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read the page after it. Omit for the first page.

connection_id.description: Only the accounts used on this WhatsApp number.

connector.description: Only accounts of this integration, by its Cosend key.

id.description: One integration account to read. Left out, the accounts are listed.

limit.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 25, maximum 100.

status.description: Only accounts in this state, e.g. connected.

name: get_integration_accounts
title: See connected integration accounts
